Swiping on the now playing full screen to view speed one way, and the podcast information, which was so easy is now gone.  It’s drop down menus.  Like this is a Mac OS application.  It’s frankly uglier.  It’s resubscribed me to long since unsubscribed applications.  It doesn’t give me an option when I click download to “download via cellular” anymore when I’m off WiFi. Which means in practice that I’m stuck with listening to yesterday’s news! Hoping there might be an improvement in an upcoming release, but if not I’m going to have to consider going to another app having been an Overcast fan for best part of ten years.

title.label: Iffy update to a great app

content.label:
I’ve used this app for years as the most customisable store for my podcasts, to the point where I’m willing to give it the benefit of the doubt after a very scratchy update and hope that with a bit of patience these issues will be fixed:

- Limit on number of episodes per podcast doesn’t seem to work. I have some news pods that refresh daily and I have them limited to 1 episode so my playlists don’t fill up, the functionality is still there in theory but doesn’t actually seem to work any more so having to do a lot of manual deletion.

- Can’t seem to reorder playlists any more.

- automatic ordering of podcasts within my playlists seems totally broken. I always sort them new to old by podcast but since the update the order has gone all over the place without me changing anything.

- Removing the option to download every podcast in a given playlist is a big backwards step. 

- Streaming option now gone - I get that there’s a reason for it but I think it’s been underestimated just how annoying this is. If streaming really is a no-go then at least restore the option mentioned above to automatically download episodes in a given playlist (rather than set individual podcast streams to download automatically/manually) so that stuff can be in place at the start of the day. Not everyone lives in a good enough area signal-wise (or has sufficient data limits) to download loads of stuff on the go.

I appreciate that the update must have taken a lot of work and the app does feel smoother and nicer to look at - but as of right now it feels like a significant backwards step. Fingers crossed the feedback is taken on board.
The update has made it so my Apple Watch doesn’t recognise a podcast is playing when it is so I have no pause or other controls available. Please fix this
